author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
We test and review a production model of the Snapmaker U1 FDM 3D printer. Here's how its multi-material tool changer works and compares with other printer designs, and why its desktop-suitable formfactor makes it unique among printers on the market today. 

Snapmaker U1: https://us.snapmaker.com/products/snapmaker-u1-3d-printer
Matterhackers filament: https://www.matterhackers.com/store/c/PLA?aff=7553
MatMireMakes Flexi models: https://www.myminifactory.com/users/MatMireMakes?show=store
Pikachu phone holder: https://makerworld.com/en/models/2051740-pikachu-phone-holder
Benchbin: https://www.printables.com/model/937776-the-benchbin-multi-color-3d-printing-torture-test/collections
Disclosure: This product was sent to us by the manufacturer for purposes of review and is not sponsored. 

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
